title: How Far Can Untrained Neural Networks Go in Anomaly Detection? From Tables to Pixels
abstract: arXiv:2611.08136v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Anomaly detection (AD) is often framed as a representation-learning problem, where strong performance is expected to require learned features or AD-specific optimization. However, this view can overlook the intrinsic separability of anomalies from normal references, even in the absence of learned representations. We therefore investigate how far untrained neural networks can go in anomaly detection. To this end, we propose PRISM, a framework combining fixed random nonlinear features with normal-reference Mahalanobis scoring for tabular detection and dense visual localization. Across 47 tabular datasets in ADBench, PRISM-T achieves the highest mean AUROC (86.4%) and the second-highest mean AUPRC (65.9%) among the compared methods. On MVTec AD and VisA, covering 27 visual categories, PRISM-V achieves mean image-level and pixel-level AUROCs of 90.4% and 96.4%, respectively. translated_title: 未经训练的神经网络在异常检测中能走多远？从表格到像素
translated_abstract: 异常检测（AD）通常被构建为一个表示学习问题，人们普遍认为要取得强性能需要学习到的特征或针对异常检测的专门优化。然而，这种观点可能忽略了异常相对于正常参照本身所具有的可分性，即使在缺乏学习到的表示的情况下也是如此。因此，我们研究了未经训练的神经网络在异常检测中能走多远。为此，我们提出了PRISM，一个将固定随机非线性特征与基于正常参照的马氏距离评分相结合的框架，可用于表格数据检测和密集视觉定位。在ADBench的47个表格数据集上，PRISM-T在所比较的方法中取得了最高的平均AUROC（86.4%）和第二高的平均AUPRC（65.9%）。在涵盖27个视觉类别的MVTec AD和VisA数据集上，PRISM-V分别取得了90.4%的平均图像级AUROC和96.4%的平均像素级AUROC。值得注意的是，两个模型均在不进行神经网络权重优化（或更新）的情况下取得了这些结果。
tldr: 提出PRISM框架，仅利用固定的随机非线性特征结合基于正常参照的马氏距离评分，无需任何训练即可在表格异常检测和视觉异常定位任务上达到最先进水平。
en_tdlr: PRISM demonstrates that untrained neural networks, combining fixed random nonlinear features with normal-reference Mahalanobis scoring, can achieve state-of-the-art anomaly detection on both tabular data and visual localization without any weight optimization.
